question:
Six boxes P, Q, R, S, T and U are painted with one among different colours Black, Blue, Orange, Green, White and Grey (not necessarily in the same order). No two boxes are painted with same colour. R is painted with orange colour. S and U are neither painted with white nor grey colour. P is painted with black colour. Q is not painted with white or blue colour.

Box S is painted with which colour?
solution:
According to the given information:

1) R is painted with orange colour.

2) P is painted with black colour.
